checks: The real project meeting-note editor saves Unicode tags, safe Markdown and both follow-current/fixed historical attachments with corroborated immutable history.
Saving an already published record creates a different current body while retaining the original published pointer; no implicit publication occurs.
A second exact edit and explicit reason/acknowledgement publish complete through actual UI/API, recorded only after authentication.
Historical restoration copies the first body into a fourth immutable revision and preserves the separately published revision.
Comments bind the actual body revision, resolve a historical pin directly, and append immutable text-only edits without replacing original attachments.
Actual scoped content reads distinguish the pinned historical bytes from the follow-current bytes and render literal script text without execution.
A real concurrent body update returns409; the editor keeps local input, disables repeat submission and explicitly rereads the latest body.
A real body-context change refuses the stale comment with409, preserves its text and prevents previous-body discussion from appearing under the new revision.
A labelled controlled response fault strips one field after the real server commits; the client stops as unconfirmed and never repeats the PATCH.
A labelled controlled filtered-reference read retains the complete server hash; editing/publication stay closed until complete authorized evidence is reread.
Actual archive/draft transitions enforce read-only archived controls, and all other three knowledge types save from the company-scope editor.
Real title/body/tag search and opaque22-record pagination work; a separately labelled synthetic403 clears cached rows, and a second actual identity owns an independent session.
